claims: Monitor blood glucose levels closely and adjust insulin therapy if necessary.
Administer IV dextrose 50% if hypoglycemia is suspected.
Re-evaluate and adjust ventilator settings if oxygen saturation remains suboptimal.
Consider empiric antibiotic therapy for potential infection given elevated lactate and leukocytosis.
Monitor electrolyte levels (potassium, chloride) and consider supplementation if low.
Assess for potential causes of anemia (e.g., occult bleeding, chronic disease) and consider appropriate investigations.
Continue close monitoring of INR and PT to ensure anticoagulation is appropriately managed.
Assess for potential respiratory complications and ensure adequate respiratory support.
Consider nutritional support if patient is unable to intake sufficient food orally.
